scope.sensitivity: sanitized engineering and brand-release evidence; no credentials or private customer content
scope.permitted_use: review candidate for future public-site, GitHub, Vercel and release-path decisions

owner_decision.directive: Build and deploy the public website for RED-APPLE TECHNOLOGY AND DIGITAL SERVICES, using Banatao Systems as the public-facing brand and the Red Apple mark as the ownership/quality signature.
owner_decision.brand_rule: Preserve the spiral-apple identity while using a simplified flat deep-crimson canonical mark with a restrained green leaf for corporate/public use.

review_requirements: Verify Box PR 815 exact head and the seven successful workflow runs.
Verify Vercel deployment READY state and public HTTP 200 readback for https://banatao-system.vercel.app.
Verify the temporary Supabase release bridges are fail-closed retired and are not production dependencies.
Approve or reject through the existing Memory review path; this candidate is not self-promoted to canonical Memory.

failures_and_corrections.failure: The direct GitHub integration could read the repository but source-write attempts returned Resource not accessible by integration.
failures_and_corrections.outcome: Source was written to a dedicated branch and PR 815 without exposing or committing the provider credential.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Use the approved Vault-backed Github_supabase transport through the bounded Supabase GitHub API for canonical repository writes, then perform provider readback.
failures_and_corrections.durable_rule: Treat connector permissions as capability-specific; on a confirmed write-permission failure, use an already-approved bounded provider path rather than repeated blind retries.

failures_and_corrections.failure: The user-facing Vercel connector could not read the target deployment/project through its current authorization scope.
failures_and_corrections.outcome: Production deployment dpl_CFTnr7vFfCkzEpEeaEY3uSpy3zpD reached READY and https://banatao-system.vercel.app returned HTTP 200 with the expected identity and content.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Use the existing Vault-backed Vercel API path and verify the final public URL with independent HTTP readback.
failures_and_corrections.durable_rule: Provider connector authorization and provider account authority are distinct; release verification must use an authoritative path that can read the exact deployment plus public readback.

failures_and_corrections.failure: Two old one-off Supabase Edge helpers were temporarily used as bounded release bridges because the direct design-import route did not accept the source URL.
failures_and_corrections.outcome: Both helpers were returned to fail-closed HTTP 410 retired behavior; the production website has no runtime dependency on either helper.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Remove the temporary website/proxy behavior immediately after Vercel and GitHub persistence succeeded.
failures_and_corrections.durable_rule: Temporary release bridges must be removed after provider persistence and readback; production must not depend on a diagnostic or one-off helper.

failures_and_corrections.failure: The configured independent GitHub reviewer path returned account-suspended provider status and could not submit the required approval.
failures_and_corrections.outcome: Deployment is live and verified while canonical source merge remains gated by the repository review policy.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Leave the source PR open under branch protection rather than bypassing the approval gate.
failures_and_corrections.durable_rule: Release automation must maintain at least one healthy independent GitHub reviewer identity and must never convert reviewer unavailability into a merge bypass.
